verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν ἐπιμένωμεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἵνα ἡ χάρις πλεονάσῃ
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen epimenōmen tē hamartia hina hē charis pleonasē
verses.literal: What then shall we say Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase
verses.literalPt: QUE diremos pois? Permaneceremos no pecado, para que a graça abunde?

verses.original: μὴ γένοιτο οἵτινες ἀπεθάνομεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ πῶς ἔτι ζήσομεν ἐν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: mē genoito hoitines apethanomen tē hamartia pōs eti zēsomen en autē
verses.literal: Certainly not How can we who died to sin live in it any longer
verses.literalPt: De modo nenhum. Nós, que estamos mortos para o pecado, como viveremos ainda nele?

verses.original: ἢ ἀγνοεῖτε ὅτι ὅσοι ἐβαπτίσθημεν εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὸν θάνατον αὐτοῦ ἐβαπτίσθημεν
verses.transliteration: ē agnoeite hoti hosoi ebaptisthēmen eis Christon Iēsoun eis ton thanaton autou ebaptisthēmen
verses.literal: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death
verses.literalPt: Ou não sabeis que todos quantos fomos batizados em Jesus Cristo fomos batizados na sua morte?

verses.original: συνετάφημεν οὖν αὐτῷ διὰ τοῦ βαπτίσματος εἰς τὸν θάνατον ἵνα ὥσπερ ἠγέρθη Χριστὸς ἐκ νεκρῶν διὰ τῆς δόξης τοῦ Πατρός οὕτως καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐν καινότητι ζωῆς περιπατήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: synetaphēmen oun autō dia tou baptismatos eis ton thanaton hina hōsper ēgerthē Christos ek nekrōn dia tēs doxēs tou Patros houtōs kai hēmeis en kainotēti zōēs peripatēsōmen
verses.literal: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death in order that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father we too may walk in newness of life
verses.literalPt: De sorte que fomos sepultados com ele pelo batismo na morte; para que, como Cristo foi ressuscitado dentre os mortos, pela glória do Pai, assim andemos nós também em novidade de vida.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ σύμφυτοι γεγόναμεν τῷ ὁμοιώματι τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ καὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως ἐσόμεθα
verses.transliteration: Ei gar symphytoi gegonamen tō homoiōmati tou thanatou autou alla kai tēs anastaseōs esometha
verses.literal: For if we have been united with Him like this . . . in His death we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection
verses.literalPt: Porque, se fomos plantados juntamente com ele na semelhança da sua morte, também o seremos na da sua ressurreição;

verses.original: τοῦτο γινώσκοντες ὅτι ὁ παλαιὸς ἡμῶν ἄνθρωπος συνεσταυρώθη ἵνα καταργηθῇ τὸ σῶμα τῆς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ μηκέτι δουλεύειν ἡμᾶς τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ
verses.transliteration: touto ginōskontes hoti ho palaios hēmōn anthrōpos synestaurōthē hina katargēthē to sōma tēs hamartias tou mēketi douleuein hēmas tē hamartia
verses.literal: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless that we should no longer be slaves to sin
verses.literalPt: Sabendo isto, que o nosso homem velho foi com ele crucificado, para que o corpo do pecado seja desfeito, para que não sirvamos mais ao pecado.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἀποθανὼν δεδικαίωται ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: ho gar apothanōn dedikaiōtai apo tēs hamartias
verses.literal: For anyone who has died has been freed from sin
verses.literalPt: Porque aquele que está morto está justificado do pecado.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ἀπεθάνομεν σὺν Χριστῷ πιστεύομεν ὅτι καὶ συζήσομεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Ei de apethanomen syn Christō pisteuomen hoti kai syzēsomen autō
verses.literal: Now if we died with Christ we believe that we will also live with Him
verses.literalPt: Ora, se já morremos com Cristo, cremos que também com ele viveremos;

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι Χριστὸς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν οὐκέτι ἀποθνῄσκει θάνατος αὐτοῦ οὐκέτι κυριεύει
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti Christos egertheis ek nekrōn ouketi apothnēskei thanatos autou ouketi kyrieuei
verses.literal: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead He cannot die again . . . death no longer has dominion over Him
verses.literalPt: Sabendo que, tendo sido Cristo ressuscitado dentre os mortos, já não morre; a morte não mais tem domínio sobre ele.

verses.original: ὃ γὰρ ἀπέθανεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἀπέθανεν ἐφάπαξ ὃ δὲ ζῇ ζῇ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ho gar apethanen tē hamartia apethanen ephapax ho de zē zē tō Theō
verses.literal: The death He died He died to sin once for all but the life He lives He lives to God
verses.literalPt: Pois, quanto a ter morrido, de uma vez morreu para o pecado; mas, quanto a viver, vive para Deus.

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς λογίζεσθε ἑαυτοὺς εἶναι νεκροὺς μὲν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ζῶντας δὲ τῷ Θεῷ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis logizesthe heautous einai nekrous men tē hamartia zōntas de tō Theō en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: So you too must count yourselves dead - to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Assim também vós considerai-vos como mortos para o pecado, mas vivos para Deus em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.

verses.original: Μὴ οὖν βασιλευέτω ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θνητῷ ὑμῶν σώματι εἰς τὸ ὑπακούειν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mē oun basileuetō hē hamartia en tō thnētō hymōn sōmati eis to hypakouein tais epithymiais autou
verses.literal: Therefore do not let sin reign . . . . . . in your mortal body so that you obey its desires
verses.literalPt: Não reine, portanto, o pecado em vosso corpo mortal, para lhe obedecerdes em suas concupiscências;

verses.original: μηδὲ παριστάνετε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν ὅπλα ἀδικίας τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἀλλὰ παραστήσατε ἑαυτοὺς τῷ Θεῷ ὡσεὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ζῶντας καὶ τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν ὅπλα δικαιοσύνης τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: mēde paristanete ta melē hymōn hopla adikias tē hamartia alla parastēsate heautous tō Theō hōsei ek nekrōn zōntas kai ta melē hymōn hopla dikaiosynēs tō Theō
verses.literal: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness
verses.literalPt: Nem tampouco apresenteis os vossos membros ao pecado por instrumentos de iniqüidade; mas apresentai-vos a Deus, como vivos dentre mortos, e os vossos membros a Deus, como instrumentos de justiça.

verses.original: ἁμαρτία γὰρ ὑμῶν οὐ κυριεύσει οὐ γάρ ἐστε ὑπὸ νόμον ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ χάριν
verses.transliteration: hamartia gar hymōn ou kyrieusei ou gar este hypo nomon alla hypo charin
verses.literal: For sin shall not be your master . . . because you are not under law but under grace
verses.literalPt: Porque o pecado não terá domínio sobre vós, pois não estais debaixo da lei, mas debaixo da graça.

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἁμαρτήσωμεν ὅτι οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑπὸ νόμον ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ χάριν μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ti oun hamartēsōmen hoti ouk esmen hypo nomon alla hypo charin mē genoito
verses.literal: What then Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace Certainly not
verses.literalPt: Pois que? Pecaremos porque não estamos debaixo da lei, mas debaixo da graça? De modo nenhum.

verses.original: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ᾧ παριστάνετε ἑαυτοὺς δούλους εἰς ὑπακοήν δοῦλοί ἐστε ᾧ ὑπακούετε ἤτοι ἁμαρτίας εἰς θάνατον ἢ ὑπακοῆς εἰς δικαιοσύνην
verses.transliteration: ouk oidate hoti hō paristanete heautous doulous eis hypakoēn douloi este hō hypakouete ētoi hamartias eis thanaton ē hypakoēs eis dikaiosynēn
verses.literal: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves you are slaves to the one you obey whether you are slaves to sin leading to death or to obedience leading to righteousness
verses.literalPt: Não sabeis vós que a quem vos apresentardes por servos para lhe obedecer, sois servos daquele a quem obedeceis, ou do pecado para a morte, ou da obediência para a justiça?

verses.original: χάρις δὲ τῷ Θεῷ ὅτι ἦτε δοῦλοι τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὑπηκούσατε δὲ ἐκ καρδίας εἰς ὃν παρεδόθητε τύπον διδαχῆς
verses.transliteration: charis de tō Theō hoti ēte douloi tēs hamartias hypēkousate de ek kardias eis hon paredothēte typon didachēs
verses.literal: But thanks be to God that though you once were slaves to sin you wholeheartedly obeyed . . . . . . the form of teaching to which you were committed
verses.literalPt: Mas graças a Deus que, tendo sido servos do pecado, obedecestes de coração à forma de doutrina a que fostes entregues.

verses.original: ἐλευθερωθέντες δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἐδουλώθητε τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: eleutherōthentes de apo tēs hamartias edoulōthēte tē dikaiosynē
verses.literal: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness
verses.literalPt: E, libertados do pecado, fostes feitos servos da justiça.

verses.original: Ἀνθρώπινον λέγω διὰ τὴν ἀσθένειαν τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν ὥσπερ γὰρ παρεστήσατε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν δοῦλα τῇ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ καὶ τῇ ἀνομίᾳ εἰς τὴν ἀνομίαν οὕτως νῦν παραστήσατε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν δοῦλα τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ εἰς ἁγιασμόν
verses.transliteration: Anthrōpinon legō dia tēn astheneian tēs sarkos hymōn hōsper gar parestēsate ta melē hymōn doula tē akatharsia kai tē anomia eis tēn anomian houtōs nyn parastēsate ta melē hymōn doula tē dikaiosynē eis hagiasmon
verses.literal: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh Just as . . . you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness
verses.literalPt: Falo como homem, pela fraqueza da vossa carne; pois que, assim como apresentastes os vossos membros para servirem à imundícia, e à maldade para maldade, assim apresentai agora os vossos membros para servirem à justiça para santificação.

verses.original: Ὅτε γὰρ δοῦλοι ἦτε τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἐλεύθεροι ἦτε τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: Hote gar douloi ēte tēs hamartias eleutheroi ēte tē dikaiosynē
verses.literal: For when you were slaves to sin you were free of obligation to righteousness
verses.literalPt: Porque, quando éreis servos do pecado, estáveis livres da justiça.

verses.original: τίνα οὖν καρπὸν εἴχετε τότε ἐφ’ οἷς νῦν ἐπαισχύνεσθε τὸ γὰρ τέλος ἐκείνων θάνατος
verses.transliteration: tina oun karpon eichete tote eph’ hois nyn epaischynesthe to gar telos ekeinōn thanatos
verses.literal: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed The outcome of those things is death
verses.literalPt: E que fruto tínheis então das coisas de que agora vos envergonhais? Porque o fim delas é a morte.

verses.original: νυνὶ δέ ἐλευθερωθέντες ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας δουλωθέντες δὲ τῷ Θεῷ ἔχετε τὸν καρπὸν ὑμῶν εἰς ἁγιασμόν τὸ δὲ τέλος ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: nyni de eleutherōthentes apo tēs hamartias doulōthentes de tō Theō echete ton karpon hymōn eis hagiasmon to de telos zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God the fruit you reap . . . leads to holiness and the outcome is eternal life
verses.literalPt: Mas agora, libertados do pecado, e feitos servos de Deus, tendes o vosso fruto para santificação, e por fim a vida eterna.

verses.original: τὰ γὰρ ὀψώνια τῆς ἁμαρτίας θάνατος τὸ δὲ χάρισμα τοῦ Θεοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιος ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: ta gar opsōnia tēs hamartias thanatos to de charisma tou Theou zōē aiōnios en Christō Iēsou tō Kyriō hēmōn
verses.literal: For the wages of sin is death but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord
verses.literalPt: Porque o salário do pecado é a morte, mas o dom gratuito de Deus é a vida eterna, por Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.
